verdicts.reason: A: the Shop Sale button sits at the far left, before the headline, so the call to action comes first in the reading order. The legal line becomes a heavy 4-line block jammed against the canvas edge, competing with the headline, and the can is tiny and crowded beside it, though all text stays readable. B: the left-to-right flow (product, headline, CTA) is better, but the legal text is squeezed to an illegible scrap above a tiny can, and the 'WEEKEND ONLY' kicker shrinks to a pink fleck crowding the button's top edge, so two text elements fail readability.
